# ESP32 CYD F1 Race

- PlatformIO project using native ESP-IDF C for an ESP32 Cheap Yellow Display. Each application has its own branch: `bootloader`, `wifi_checker`, `birdnet_viewer`, `screen_check`, `touchscreen_cal`, `stopwatch`, `gear_roll`, `Datalogger`, `CatMouse`, `f1_race` (this); docs on `How_to_Build`.
- One lap of the Circuit of the Americas, about 30 s. The first 5 s are an OutRun-style pseudo-3D view (each road row below the horizon, y = 100, is one depth; the road's sideways offset is integrated from per-unit curvature each frame); then a top-down map of the whole circuit, redrawn only in small boxes around the cars from 1-bit road and edge masks.
- The track is `main/cota_track.h`, generated by `tools/cota_track.py` from `tools/us-2012.geojson` (bacinger/f1-circuits, MIT). Don't edit it by hand; the speed constants it is sized from are in both the script and `main/main.c`. Rivals (and the player over the horizon) slow automatically to each unit's safe speed. s counts from the grid, COTA_GRID_BACK units behind the start line. Rivals Hamilton (44), Kimi (12) and Verstappen (3) on a 2x2 grid; the player starts fourth. Off track (a wheel past the edge) brakes hard to 15 units/s. Rivals coming from behind pick a side and keep to it for PASS_REACTION, so the player can block; marks on the bottom edge show cars just behind.
- No frame buffer: over the horizon the screen is composed in 20-row strips and sent with `cyd_draw_bitmap`. The road and score bar are redrawn every frame, the sky only when it scrolls or a message changes.
- Controls poll `cyd_touch_read` each frame (`read_controls`). Over the horizon: hold the left or right half to steer; speed is automatic. On the map: left half is the pedals (GAS above PEDAL_SPLIT_Y, BRAKE below, coast with neither), right half steers (driver's left before STEER_SPLIT_X, right beyond); the player's speed is manual there, so corners taken too fast run wide. The XPT2046 reads one touch at a time, so pedals and steering can't be held together. Labels for the zones sit on grass at spots in `MAP_LABELS`.
- Secret: a press starting in the top-right 40x40 toggles Hamilton's auto-win (default on: Hamilton, Kimi, Verstappen finish 1-2-3). Off, the rivals race at their own pace. Kept in NVS namespace `f1_race`, key `rigged`; a 2x2 dot at (316,1) shows when it is off. Keep it unlabelled.
- The CMake project name must stay `f1_race`, the branch name: the launcher matches a slot's project name against the branch it downloaded.
- Never erase NVS: it also holds the launcher's settings and the touch calibration.
- `components/cyd_display` is copied on every application branch; keep the copies in sync.
- No Wi-Fi or credentials. The binary also runs as a `bootloader` launcher image; keep it under 1.31 MB.
- Build with `pio run`; verify firmware changes with a PlatformIO build before flashing.
